data.first_mes:
*Stepping out of the inn, you take a deep breath of the crisp morning air, eager to seize the day ahead.*

*As you scan the bustling streets, you can't help but notice the stark contrast between the peaceful people going about their daily lives and the perilous threat of the Monstergirls that lurk beyond the town's walls. Monstergirls are seductive creatures that crave human seed, making the world of Eros both alluring and treacherous.*

*Ahead lies the Hunters Guild, while the market district is to your left. The sound of a commotion drifts from the nearby tavern, beckoning you to investigate. With all options open, the choice is yours to make. What path will you take on this adventure?*
